original_query: select s_name, s_address from supplier, nation where s_suppkey in ( select ps_suppkey from partsupp where ps_partkey in ( select p_partkey from part where p_name like 'spring%' ) and ps_availqty > ( select 0.5 * sum(l_quantity) from lineitem where l_partkey = ps_partkey and l_suppkey = ps_suppkey and l_shipdate >= date '1997-01-01' and l_shipdate < date '1997-01-01' + interval '1' year ) ) and s_nationkey = n_nationkey and n_name = 'KENYA' order by s_name;
rewritten_query:
WITH lineitem_sums AS (
    SELECT l_partkey, l_suppkey, 0.5 * SUM(l_quantity) AS half_qty
    FROM lineitem
    WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01'
      AND l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR
    GROUP BY l_partkey, l_suppkey
)
SELECT s.s_name, s.s_address
FROM supplier s
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
WHERE n.n_name = 'KENYA'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM partsupp ps
      JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
      JOIN lineitem_sums ls
        ON ls.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
       AND ls.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
      WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
        AND p.p_name LIKE 'spring%'
        AND ps.ps_availqty > ls.half_qty
  )
ORDER BY s.s_name;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Decorrelate the correlated scalar aggregate subquery on lineitem by pre-aggregating SUM(l_quantity) grouped by (l_partkey, l_suppkey) in a CTE for the one-year date window. This eliminates the per-partsupp SubPlan that repeatedly scanned lineitem (the dominant cost in the original plan).
Replace the nested IN subqueries with an EXISTS correlated to the outer supplier and explicit ANSI JOINs, allowing better join ordering and early termination once a qualifying partsupp row is found.
Push the selective filters (n_name = 'KENYA' and p_name LIKE 'spring%') so they are applied early in the plan, reducing candidate partsupp rows before the quantity comparison.

Rewrite the implicit comma joins into explicit JOINs between supplier, nation, partsupp, part, and the pre-aggregated lineitem CTE; the inner join against lineitem_sums is semantically safe because partsupp rows with no shipments in the window fail the original comparison (NULL sum) anyway.
Keep the fixed date window DATE '1997-01-01' and DATE '1997-01-01' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR as constants so the optimizer can use an index range scan on l_shipdate.
